name: tags
title: Tags
description: A field that turns what is typed into values, each a chip in the well.
use: A short list of free values a reader types: labels, keywords, email addresses. Put the tags class on an input group with input-group-wrap; its chips are the values and its field takes the next one. A value the behavior refuses marks the field aria-invalid="true", which the input group draws.

instead.when: The values come from a known list
A few known options are switched on and off

keyboard.action: Turn the field's text into a value; Enter in an empty field is left to the form
In an empty field, move to the last value; on a value, remove it and move to the one before
On a value, remove it and move to the one after
From the start of the field, move to the last value; between values, move to the one before or after, and past the last back to the field. The other way around from right to left
On a value, move to the first value, or back to the field
On a value, return to the field

platform.fallback: A new value appears without growing in

classes.name: tags
classes.description: On an input group with input-group-wrap: the values are its chips and the field takes the next one, keeping room for a word before it wraps to a line of its own

properties.name: --tags-field-min
properties.description: The narrowest the field becomes before it wraps to a line of its own

example: design research
